programme.title: Caffeinated
programme.desc: Learn the story behind your morning Joe. From seed to mug, coffee, and the process by which it is created, has shaped the lives of thousands of individuals worldwide. Caffeinated gives the coffee consumer unprecedented access to the farmers responsible for growing that perfect bean, and the roasters and baristas responsible for brewing that perfect cup. Directed by Vishal Solanki.

programme.title: Tabloid
programme.desc: Oscar-winner Errol Morris tells a twisted true tale of love, abduction, cloned dogs and Mormons in bondage, ripped from the headlines of 1970s tabloids.

programme.title: The Jeffrey Dahmer Files
programme.desc: A dark and disturbing exploration of America's most infamous serial killer, Jeffrey Dahmer, as seen through the eyes of the arresting officer and his next door neighbor. Directed by Chris James Thompson.

programme.title: Room 237
programme.desc: Stanley Kubrick's classic film, 'The Shining', gets a riveting and in-depth exploration of its hidden meanings, dazzling puzzles and even conspiracy theories.

programme.title: Take Every Wave: The Life Of Laird Hamilton
programme.desc: Experience the white-knuckle thrill of big wave surfing through the eyes of Laird Hamilton, a living legend who conquers the world's mightiest tides. Directed by Rory Kennedy.

programme.title: 78/52: Hitchcock's Shower Scene
programme.desc: Just when you thought it was safe to go back in the shower... Discover how Alfred Hitchcock's Psycho changed film history forever with one shocking scene. Directed by Alexandre O. Philippe.

programme.title: Je Suis Elodie
programme.desc: Elodie is a young mother and a biologist working to cure cancer whose work and personal lives collide when she gets a breast cancer diagnosis. Directed by Tabs Breese and India Wadsworth.

programme.title: ifine
programme.desc: Set in Sierra Leone’s Kono district, ifine is a documentary that explores the beauty of Blackness through the eyes of youth coming of age amid a skin bleaching epidemic. Directed by Ebony Gilbert and - Adisa Septuri.

programme.title: The Seven Five
programme.desc: Meet the dirtiest cop in NYC history. Michael Dowd stole money and dealt drugs while patrolling the streets of 80s Brooklyn. He tells all in this explosive true crime saga. Directed by Tiller Russell.

programme.title: Lost in La Mancha
programme.desc: Follow director Terry Gilliam on his quest to bring the story of Don Quixote to the "big screen". At times hilarious, it's a unique, in-depth look at the harsher realities of filmmaking. Directed by Keith Fulton and Louis Pepe.

programme.title: Weiner
programme.desc: Sexts, lies & Carlos Danger. Get an inside peek at one of the biggest political scandals ever: Anthony Weiner's wild "comeback" mayoral run. Winner, Sundance Grand Jury Prize. Directed by Josh Kriegman and Elyse Steinberg.

programme.title: Sharksploitation
programme.desc: The ultimate deep dive into the world of shark cinema: filmmakers, critics, scholars, and conservationists explore the cultural impact on audiences and this misunderstood species. Directed by Stephen Scarlata.

programme.title: Chicken Stories
programme.desc: A group of friends use Siri to guide them as they band together to start a farm, in a short documentary by Jonathan Pickett.

programme.title: The Search for General Tso
programme.desc: This mouthwateringly entertaining documentary traces the surprising origins of the iconic Chinese-American dish, from Shanghai to Middle America and beyond.

programme.title: We Are Oscar Mike
programme.desc: Through his non-profit foundation, Oscar Mike, Noah helps rehabilitate other veterans through the adaptive sports that saved his own life. Directed by Nick Cavalier.

programme.title: Osama & Ayman
programme.desc: Osama and Ayman Abdeldayem skate through the streets of our nation's capital, while navigating growing Islamophobia with style and humor. Directed by Ben Mullinkosson, Sam Price-Waldman, and Chris Cresci.

programme.title: NZINGHA
programme.desc: Nzingha Prescod is the #2 ranked women's foil fencer in the United States. In 2015, Nzingha became the first African-American woman to win an individual medal at the Senior World Championships. Should she medal individually in Rio at the 2016 Summer Olympics, she will be the first African-American woman to do so in the history of the sport. Directed by Anderson Wright.

programme.title: Kid Yamaka
programme.desc: This deeply human story explores boxer Zachary "Kid Yamaka” Wohlman’s difficult past, his training under world-class coach Freddie Roach, and his path to personal redemption through boxing, Judaism, and sobriety. With Zachary’s 2021 passing, this film serves as a moving tribute to his hustle, heart and soul and to all those who struggle with addiction. Directed by Matt Ogens.

programme.title: Strike
programme.desc: Bill Fong is passionate about bowling. One seeming ordinary night all may change for this underdog as Fong begins to get strike after strike, nearing the ever elusive 'perfect series.' Directed by Joey Daoud.

programme.title: Framing John Delorean
programme.desc: Money, power, politics, drugs, scandal, and fast cars. Discover the untold story of the controversial automaker's meteoric rise and shocking fall. Featuring Alec Baldwin. Directed by Don Argott and Sheena M. Joyce.
